newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HANSA KEEPS TO PROFIT ESTIMATE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HANSA KEEPS TO PROFIT ESTIMATE.

text.p: Hansapank said on Tuesday that its April profit was as expected and it has no plans to revise its forecast now.
"The profit was relatively as expected, it is neither positive nor negative," Rain Lohmus, vice chairman of Hansapank, told Reuters.
Lohmus said Hansapank will not revise its profit forecast now and is waiting for the half-year results.
"The first quarter was good for everybody and we should wait for the second quarter," he added.
Hansapank's April profit was 26.1 million kroons and it has made a net profit of 122.5 million kroons this year. Its profit estimate is 256 million kroons for 1997.
